study: MMASD quality-aware self-supervised spatiotemporal graph learning
status: initial experiment completed; results are preliminary

data.input_shape: variable time x 8 body groups x 8 kinematic features

method.spatial_graph: anatomical graph over eight body groups plus self loops
method.temporal_encoder: bidirectional GRU over spatially pooled graph features
method.self_supervised_objective: reconstruct artificially masked body-group feature vectors
method.quality_signal: observed body-group mask; controlled synthetic missingness only

evaluation: five size-balanced outer folds grouped by stored subject identifiers; validation groups and all fitted normalization are separated from outer test groups
group_identity_caveat: Stored filename-derived group identifiers have not been independently verified as participant identities.
data_limitations: The cached features do not include per-joint detector confidence or true missing-joint masks.
Synthetic body-group masking tests controlled robustness; it is not a substitute for real pose-quality metadata.
This result is a ten/eleven-class activity-recognition task (the local cache has eleven classes), not autism diagnosis.
